content.title: Online Lazy Loading Generator
content.p1: Improve your website's perceived performance and Core Web Vitals with our Image Lazy-Load Generator. By using Low Quality Image Placeholders (LQIP), you can show users a blurred or solid color preview while the full image loads in the background.
content.p2: This tool automatically creates the tiny base64 placeholder and provides the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript needed to implement efficient lazy loading.
